text:
Advisor: So, to recap, you've been trading mostly altcoins on a spot account for about six months?
Client: Right. And, uh, I'm up around thirty percent but I honestly don't know if that's luck or skill.
Advisor: Fair question. Let's look at your trade log. You made forty-two trades. Win rate is about forty-five percent, but your average win is twice the size of your average loss. That's a positive expectancy, so it's not purely luck.
Client: Oh, that's good to hear. I mostly just use a moving average crossover and some support levels.
Advisor: Okay. The weakness I see is concentration. Sixty percent of your portfolio is in two small-cap tokens. If one of them gets delisted from the exchange, you can't exit.
Client: Yeah, there was a delisting scare last month, actually.
Advisor: Exactly. I'd cap any single altcoin at ten percent and keep at least thirty percent in BTC or stablecoins. Also set alerts on exchange announcements.
Client: What about trading fees? I think I'm paying a lot.
Advisor: You're paying taker fees on most orders. Use limit orders and check the VIP tier discount if you pay fees in the exchange token.
Client: Okay. And for taxes, do I report every trade?
Advisor: In most jurisdictions, yes, each disposal is taxable. Export the full trade history from the exchange at year end and keep it.
Client: Alright. I'll do that. Thanks for the clear plan.

metadata.note: consultation on swing trading plan and taxes on trading gains
